2609.04869.title: From Interaction Traces to Persistent Skills: Online Evolution for Computer-Use Agents
2609.04869.paper_summary: Computer-use agents can execute increasingly complex tasks in graphical interfaces, but their interaction experience is typically transient: procedural knowledge acquired from one rollout is not systematically retained, refined, and reused in later tasks. Existing skill libraries provide external procedural knowledge, yet their incremental value over the same agent operating without skills, as well as their longitudinal dynamics under repeated interaction, remain insufficiently characterized. We present an online skill-evolution framework that converts interaction trajectories and evaluator feedback into a persistent, versioned library of reusable procedures. Each iteration executes against a frozen library snapshot, and evidence-guided skill updates become available in subsequent iterations without changing model parameters. We compare the full evolving-library system with a configuration-matched empty-library control across four OSWorld application domains under the same fixed action-generation and GUI-grounding stack, task sets, and iteration horizons. Following a five-iteration empty-library warm-up, Full attains a higher post-warm-up mean evaluator score in all four observed domain runs, with mean differences ranging from 5.7 to 18.6 percentage points and domain-dependent temporal stability. In GIMP, provenance-aware analysis reveals retrieval across task-of-origin boundaries and revision churn, where repeated accepted edits fail to recover the originating task. These findings characterize evolving skill libraries as auditable, shared procedural memory that can improve a fixed computer-use stack, while showing that their benefits are conditional and repeated revision does not guarantee recovery. Code is released at https://github.com/LongtaoHu/Skill-Evo4GUI.
2609.04869.paper_summary_zh: 電腦使用代理可以在圖形介面中執行越來越複雜的任務，但它們的互動體驗通常是短暫的：從一次展開中獲得的程序性知識並未在後續任務中系統性地保留、精煉和重用。現有的技能庫提供外部程序性知識，但它們相較於同一代理在沒有技能的情況下運行的增量價值，以及在重複互動下的長期動態，仍然未得到充分的特徵描述。我們提出了一個在線技能演變框架，將互動軌跡和評估者反饋轉換為持久的、版本化的可重用程序庫。每次迭代都在凍結的庫快照上執行，並且證據引導的技能更新在隨後的迭代中可用，而不改變模型參數。我們在四個 OSWorld 應用領域中，將完整的演變庫系統與配置匹配的空庫控制進行比較，這些比較是在相同的固定動作生成和 GUI 基礎堆棧、任務集和迭代範圍下進行的。在經過五次迭代的空庫熱身後，完整系統在所有四個觀察到的領域運行中達到了更高的熱身後平均評估者分數，平均差異範圍從 5.7 到 18.6 個百分點，並且在領域上依賴的時間穩定性。在 GIMP 中，具有來源意識的分析揭示了跨越任務來源邊界的檢索和修訂變更，其中重複接受的編輯未能恢復原始任務。這些發現將演變的技能庫特徵化為可審計的、共享的程序記憶，這可以改善固定的電腦使用堆棧，同時顯示其好處是有條件的，且重複修訂並不保證恢復。代碼已在 https://github.com/LongtaoHu/Skill-Evo4GUI 上發布。
